title: Student Identity Disclosure
description: Student (EE1) is exposed to the Grades Portal Web App (P1) during the login and submission process. The student's identity is transmitted to the external process, which may log or store this information, creating a privacy risk.
assumptions: The student's identity is not encrypted or anonymized before transmission.

title: Data Processing of Student Information
description: The Grades Portal Web App (P1) processes student data (student id, course, submission timestamp) and may store or log this information, creating a privacy risk.
assumptions: The portal does not use encryption or anonymization for the stored data.

title: Identifier Exposure
description: The data flow transmits student identifiers (student id, course, file reference) from the Portal Web App (P1) to the Assignment & Grading Service (P2). This constitutes an Identifying threat (I) as the data contains unique references to the identity of the data subject.

title: Identifier Exposure
description: The data flow transmits student identifiers (student id, course, file reference) from the Assignment & Grading Service (P2) back to the Portal Web App (P1). This constitutes an Identifying threat (I) as the data contains unique references to the identity of the data subject.

title: Assignment File Disclosure
description: The assignment file containing student personal data (student id, course, submission time) is transferred from the Assignment & Grading Service (Process P2) to the Assignment Store (DataStore DS1). This constitutes a Data Disclosure (D) threat as it represents the transfer of personal data across a boundary.

title: Assignment File Disclosure
description: The assignment file containing student personal data is transferred from the Assignment Store (DataStore DS1) to the Assignment & Grading Service (Process P2). This constitutes a Data Disclosure (D) threat as it represents the transfer of personal data across a boundary.

title: Teacher's Data Access
description: Teacher (EE3) requests and processes the queue of submissions to review for their courses, which may contain personally identifiable information (PII) or sensitive data.
assumptions: The teacher has access to the queue of submissions and the system processes this data for review purposes.

title: System Data Processing
description: The Grades Portal Web App (P1) processes the queue of submissions, which may include sensitive data accessed by the teacher.
assumptions: The system processes the queue of submissions for review.

title: Data Leakage
description: Process P1 (Grades Portal Web App) may inadvertently expose student names, work content, and submission times to the external Teacher entity (EE3) without proper access controls or encryption.
assumptions: The portal is accessible to the teacher, and the teacher has the necessary permissions to view this data.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if the teacher has explicit permission to view this specific data set. Assuming access for the purpose of threat modeling.

title: Data Leakage
description: External Entity (Teacher) may inadvertently expose student names, work content, and submission times to the Portal (P1) without proper access controls or encryption.
assumptions: The teacher has the necessary permissions to view this specific data set.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if the portal has explicit permission to view this specific data set. Assuming access for the purpose of threat modeling.

title: Teacher records grade
description: Teacher (EE3) records a grade for a student, which may contain sensitive personal information (e.g., student ID, name) that is not encrypted or protected by the system.

title: Teacher records feedback
description: Teacher (EE3) records written feedback for a student, which may contain sensitive personal information (e.g., student ID, name) that is not encrypted or protected by the system.

title: Teacher records grade and feedback
description: Teacher (EE3) records a grade and written feedback for a student, which may contain sensitive personal information (e.g., student ID, name) that is not encrypted or protected by the system.

title: Process records grade
description: Process (P1) records a grade for a student, which may contain sensitive personal information (e.g., student ID, name) that is not encrypted or protected by the system.

title: Process records feedback
description: Process (P1) records written feedback for a student, which may contain sensitive personal information (e.g., student ID, name) that is not encrypted or protected by the system.

title: Process records grade and feedback
description: Process (P1) records a grade and written feedback for a student, which may contain sensitive personal information (e.g., student ID, name) that is not encrypted or protected by the system.

title: Grade Record Exposure
description: The assignment service (P2) writes grade records (student id, course, grade, feedback, grader id, timestamp) to the Grade Records Database (DS2). If the database is not properly secured or if the write operation is not restricted to authorized users, sensitive student and course information could be exposed.
assumptions: Assumes the database is not already fully secured.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if the database is fully secured; this is a general risk for any write operation to a data store.

title: Data Store Write Access
description: The Grade Records Database (DS2) is being written to by the assignment service (P2). This write operation could be accessed by unauthorized users or entities if the database's access controls are not properly implemented.
assumptions: Assumes the database's access controls are not fully implemented.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if the database's access controls are fully implemented; this is a general risk for any write operation to a data store.

title: Unauthorized Access to Personal Data
description: External entity (Student) requests and receives personally identifiable information (PII) from the system without explicit consent or a valid data flow model.
assumptions: The student has not explicitly authorized the system to access their personal grades and feedback.

title: Data Processing of Personal Data
description: The Grades Portal Web App processes personally identifiable information (PII) from the student without a valid data flow model or explicit authorization.
assumptions: The system processes student grades and feedback without a documented data flow model.

title: Grade Display to Student
description: Process P1 (Grades Portal Web App) displays student grades to ExternalEntity EE1 (Student). This interaction is valid (Process->ExternalEntity) and exposes sensitive personal data (grades) to an external entity without appropriate access controls.

title: Student Access to Grades
description: ExternalEntity EE1 (Student) accesses and views their own grades. This is a valid interaction (ExternalEntity->Process) but the student entity itself does not have modeled flows between other external entities, and the exposure of grades to the student is a privacy risk.

title: Unauthorized Grade Access
description: Parent (EE2) logs in and requests their child's grades. If the parent account is not properly linked to the child account, or if the system does not enforce access control based on the parent-child relationship, an unauthorized individual could access the child's grades.
assumptions: The parent account is linked to the child account.

title: Data Exfiltration
description: Process P1 (Grades Portal Web App) processes data from Parent (EE2). If the system does not validate the parent-child relationship before processing the request, the parent's account could be used to access data intended for the child.
assumptions: The system validates the parent-child relationship before processing the request.

title: Grade Display to Parent
description: Process P1 (Grades Portal Web App) displays child's grades, feedback, and submission history to ExternalEntity EE2 (Parent). This interaction is valid under the Process->ExternalEntity mapping table, but the display of sensitive personal data (grades, feedback, history) to an external entity without explicit consent or a data processing agreement constitutes a privacy violation.
assumptions: The portal is accessible to the parent without a formal data processing agreement.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if the parent has explicit consent for viewing grades and history.

title: Parent Access to Child's Data
description: ExternalEntity EE2 (Parent) accesses child's grades, feedback, and submission history. This is an invalid interaction (ExternalEntity->Process) as external entities outside the system do not have modeled flows between each other. The parent is accessing data that is not part of the system's data flow.
assumptions: The parent is accessing data without a formal data processing agreement.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if the parent has explicit consent for accessing grades and history.

title: Unauthorized Account Creation
description: ExternalEntity (EE4) creates accounts without proper authorization or verification.

title: Unauthorized Account Modification
description: ExternalEntity (EE4) modifies account details (names, emails, roles) without authorization.

title: Unauthorized Account Disabling
description: ExternalEntity (EE4) disables accounts without authorization.

title: Unauthorized Account Creation
description: Process (P1) creates accounts without proper authorization or verification.

title: Unauthorized Account Modification
description: Process (P1) modifies account details (names, emails, roles) without authorization.

title: Unauthorized Account Disabling
description: Process (P1) disables accounts without authorization.

title: Unauthorized Access to Grading Service
description: An unauthorized user or process may access the grading service (P2) to view or modify account records or parent-child relationship links before they are written to the account directory (DS3).

title: Data Modification in Grading Service
description: An unauthorized user or process may modify the grading service (P2) to alter account records or parent-child relationship links before they are written to the account directory (DS3).

title: Grade Records Access
description: DataStore DS2 (Grade Records Database) is accessed by Process P2 (Assignment & Grading Service) to build views for students, parents, and teachers. This interaction is valid under the mapping table (DataStore->Process).
assumptions: The data flow is authorized and the data is not sensitive.

title: Grade Records Access
description: Process P2 (Assignment & Grading Service) accesses DataStore DS2 (Grade Records Database) to retrieve grade records for building views.
assumptions: The process has appropriate access controls and authorization.
